item.title: RollPacker: Proposing a Synchronous Algorithm and Addressing Its Challenges

item.description: My first exploration of RLHF infrastructure through HybridFlow: controller paradigms, hierarchical APIs, the 3D-HybridEngine, and automatic device mapping.
